coverage_notes.result_summary: CMS Public Notices checked first and remains current through November 2, 2026. Twelve additional targeted searches covered US hospitals/ED, maternity, psychiatric/behavioral health, dialysis, oncology, rural emergency services, primary care, ground and air EMS, official state access restrictions, concrete reopening and US territories. No newly verified nonduplicate concrete healthcare-access disruption or restoration in the November 8 06:47:51–07:43:15 PST observation window. Relevant indexed hits were historical, previously recorded, non-US or future timestamped.
coverage_limitations: Supplementary bounded recall is not comprehensive national/territorial surveillance.
Sunday early-morning local reporting may be delayed in web search indexing.
No independent production-collector deduplication was performed; duplicates were checked against verified watch-ledger receipts and source event dates.
